data.name: Sahdev
data.gender_notes: Sahdev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sah means 'complete' and Dev means 'god'. This name is given to the deity who is believed to be the god of the earth and is considered to be the ruler of all the underworld. He is believed to be the god of agriculture, wealth, and prosperity. Sahdev is also known as Sahasralinga, which means 'thousand-hooded'. The name Sahdev carries the meaning “God of the earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sahdev usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the earth and the divine grace of the god. It represents the strength, stability, and courage to overcome any challenges. Sahdev is a name that inspires respect and awe.
data.etymology: Sahdev belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahdev total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Sahdev is considered to be an important deity in Hindu culture, especially in the northern and central regions of India. He is worshipped by farmers in the hope of securing a bountiful harvest, and his influence can be seen in many Hindu rituals and festivals related to agriculture. Sahdev is also considered to be an important god in the Shaivite tradition of Hinduism.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sahdev signifies completeness and divine presence. It is believed that Sahdev represents the aspect of God that governs the earth and all its resources. By invoking the name of Sahdev, one can seek blessings for prosperity, wealth, and agricultural success. He is also considered an auspicious deity, and his name is often chanted during religious ceremonies and rituals to bring about good fortune and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sahdev: Truthful Devotee. A name signifying unwavering devotion to truth and God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sahadeva was the youngest brother of Bhimasena (Bhim) and Yudhishthira in the Mahabharata. The name Sahdev carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: Sahdev is a name of Hindu origin, derived from the Sanskrit language. It is commonly used as a given name in the Hindu community, particularly in India. The name is associated with the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic, where Sahadeva is the youngest brother of Bhima and Yudhishthira.
